Scene:
比方说，他一次试一试有些植物的叶，吃得又新鲜又甜。煮这些叶以后，他一喝就知道他发现新的茶叶。虽然他找到了很多的新的植物，但是他的旅程有的时候特别是危险。比方说，他一吃灵芝就开始生病。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 他一次试一试有些植物的叶，吃得又新鲜又甜：有一次；试了试，了completed; 叶子；吃起来
- 煮这些叶以后，他一喝就知道他发现新的茶叶：煮了，了completed; 叶子
- 虽然他找到了很多的新的植物：很多新的植物
- 但是他的旅程有的时候特别是危险：特别危险，”特别是+N, + Clause” is used to single out a typical example
- 他一吃灵芝就开始生病：wrong information, 灵芝is a medicine

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: Coherence (Temporality): 他一喝就知道他发现新的茶叶：他一喝就发现了这是一种茶叶，发现 is a completed realization in this event, so it takes 了; this wording also directly expresses what he realizes. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
Run 2: Coherence (Temporality): 发现新的茶叶：发现了新的茶叶，The discovery happens as a completed result after he drinks the leaves, so use 了 after the verb. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
Run 3: Coherence (Temporality): 发现新的茶叶：发现了新的茶叶，This discovery is presented as a completed result after he drinks the tea, so use “了.” [rule: aspect_le_completed]

output.reason: All runs target the missing completed-aspect 了 after 发现, but Run 1 changes the complement to 这是一种茶叶 while Runs 2–3 retain 新的茶叶, so they are not the same fix.
